First, note that May 1752 is during the Julian-to-Gregorian calendar transition in Britain/American colonies, but the question asks for simple Gregorian arithmetic ignoring that transition for forward calculation.  

Start: 1752-05 (May 1752)  
Add 39 years: 1791-05  
Add 3 months: 1791-08 (August 1791)  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1791-08
